title: Scarab pool
description: A block producer: forging, KES and the certificate, the rotation driver, sync and peers.

panels.title: Node alerts firing
panels.description: Firing pool alerts carrying the selected node labels. Host-only rotation and global missing-metrics alerts are shown separately below.

targets.expr: count by (host, container) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Pool.*", host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) or on (host, container) (0 * min by (host, container) (up{job="scarab", host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

panels.title: Node up
panels.description: 1 when the node's /metrics answers the scrape.

panels.title: Phase
panels.description: Restoring, Replaying or Following; a producer forges only while Following.

panels.title: Stalls begun (range)
panels.description: Watchdog stalls begun in the interval. A current stalled-state gauge is unavailable on some deployed builds.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the process started; a drop to near zero is a restart.

panels.title: Host rotation alerts firing
panels.description: KES driver alerts carry host only, so node/container filtering must not hide them. Missing driver telemetry remains missing.

targets.expr: count by (host) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"PoolKesRotation.*", host=~"$host"}) or on (host) (0 * max by (host) (scarab_kes_rotation_last_run_timestamp_seconds{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Global rotation-metrics alert
panels.description: Fleet-wide alert from absent(driver metrics), which has no host or container labels. Intentionally unfiltered: 0 means this specific global alert is not firing.

panels.title: Driver sample age
panels.description: Age of the ingested textfile metric, not the time since rotation ran. Compare Last run below.

panels.title: Blocks adopted (range)
panels.description: Forged blocks that became the tip of our chain.

panels.title: Blocks lost (range)
panels.description: Forged blocks that did not stay on our chain (a lost slot battle, or replaced).

panels.title: Forge failures (range)
panels.description: Increase in the cumulative cannot-forge gauge (treated as a monotonic total with reset correction). Slots our pool led but could not forge in (`forgeFailed`).

panels.title: Expected per epoch
panels.description: The expected blocks per epoch for the pool's stake share (the `expected` box above).

panels.title: Blocks per epoch against the expectation
panels.description: A sliding window of one epoch (the `epoch` box: 5d on Preprod and Mainnet, 1d on Preview). The pool should hover around the expected line; a single epoch varies a lot (Poisson).

panels.title: Leader slots checked and won (per hour)
panels.description: Slots the forger checked for leadership against the slots the pool led; checked should be about one per second of a Following node.

panels.title: Slots that could not be forged or were skipped
KES periods remaining
panels.description: Alerts: warning below 10, critical below 3.

panels.title: Certificate counter
panels.description: The issue counter of the certificate in use; it rises by one with each rotation.

panels.title: KES persist failures (range)
panels.description: Evolved keys that could not be written back to the key file.

panels.title: KES periods: remaining, current and expiry
panels.description: Remaining climbs back each time the rotation driver installs a new certificate.

panels.title: Certificate counter and reloads by outcome
Last success
panels.description: Time since a run ended with exit status 0. Alert: critical beyond 3 hours.

panels.title: Last exit status
panels.description: 0 ok, 1 reload refused, 2 not confirmed, 3 node unreachable, 4 setup wrong.

panels.title: Last rotation
panels.description: Time since the node confirmed credentials the driver installed.

panels.title: Driver: periods remaining when it last looked
Slot lag behind the peers' tip
panels.description: Last peer tip reported at follower extension minus our selected tip; not wall-clock lag or an independent network-tip measurement. Alert: above 120 for 10 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Peers hot
panels.description: Ordinary + big-ledger active peers; local roots are subsets, not additional peers.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Hot_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_HotBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Warm_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_WarmBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Cold_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ColdBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Our tip and the peers' tip (slot)

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Hot_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_HotBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Warm_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_WarmBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Cold_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ColdBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Restarts (process start time)
panels.description: A step is a restart (seconds since 1970).
